title: 8TH EDITION OF INDIA–MYANMAR NAVAL EXERCISE (IMNEX-26) CULMINATES AT VISAKHAPATNAM
body_text: The 8th edition of the India–Myanmar Naval Exercise (IMNEX-26) concluded at Visakhapatnam on 14 Nov 2026, following the successful completion of its Harbour and Sea Phases. The Sea Phase in the Bay of Bengal marked the operational culmination of the exercise, with Indian Naval Ships INS Rana and INS Sumedha operating alongside Myanmar Navy Ship UMS King Sin Phyu Shin . The Harbour Phase comprised Subject Matter Expert Exchanges (SMEEs), cross-deck visits, professional interactions and sporting engagements, facilitating the exchange of operational knowledge and experience between personnel of the two navies. The Sea Phase involved coordinated maritime manoeuvres and operational drills, providing an opportunity to refine procedures, enhance tactical coordination and strengthen interoperability among participating units. IMNEX-26 provided a valuable platform for participating ships and personnel to consolidate operational understanding and enhance familiarity with each other's capabilities and procedures. The exercise further advances bilateral naval engagement and is aligned with India's vision of MAHASAGAR (Mutual and Holistic Advancement for Security and Growth Across Regions) and Neighbourhood First policy. ______________________________________________________________ VM/AS                                                                                                          247/26
